cards.label: Operating & partnering · Barry’s
cards.title: Barry’s, market by market.
cards.desc: Ten years with the boutique fitness brand from Los Angeles: CEO of Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic from 2016, through the 2022 merger with the Norwegian franchisee, and partner in the Barry’s companies in Iberia and Switzerland.
items: CEO & Partner, Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic AB
Studios in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Spain and Switzerland

cards.label: Investing · Stockholm Leisure Partners
cards.title: Capital for health and fitness.
cards.desc: Founding partner, since 2015, of Stockholm Leisure Partners, an investor focused on the health and fitness industry.

cards.label: Sport · Boards
cards.title: A seat in Swedish sport.
cards.desc: Elected to the board of Svensk Innebandy in June 2026; a board member of AIK since March 2026.
items: His stated aim: a stronger elite game, sportingly, commercially and organisationally

sections.label: In his words
sections.title: From his <t>LinkedIn.</t>

items.q: “So proud to share that Barry’s Helsinki is officially open 🇫🇮🔥 Huge thanks to everyone who made this happen — it’s been an incredible team effort! See you on the treadmill.”

items.t: Elected to the board of Svensk Innebandy.
items.q: “Jag är både stolt och ödmjuk över att i helgen ha blivit vald till ledamot i förbundsstyrelsen för Svensk Innebandy.”
items.s: LinkedIn, June 2026 · “Both proud and humble to have been elected to the board of Svensk Innebandy this weekend.”

items.t: A new board, a new season.
items.q: “Inspirerande start med nya förbundsstyrelsen och Sportkontoret! Ser fram emot att bidra till utvecklingen av svensk innebandy – och inte minst till att stärka elitinnebandyn sportsligt, kommersiellt och organisatoriskt. Let’s go!”
items.s: LinkedIn, September 2026 · “Looking forward to contributing to Swedish floorball, and not least to strengthening the elite game sportingly, commercially and organisationally.”

steps.d: The subjects, and how they are worded, are agreed with Johan before launch.
Read by Johan or his office. Nothing confidential is asked for at first contact.
What is welcome, and how quickly, stays his decision. The platform only makes the first step clear.

It is not his official website and has not been reviewed or approved by him. Portraits and studio scenes are AI-generated art direction based on public photographs; they do not record real events or places. Copy, figures and photography remain subject to his validation. The page is excluded from search engines.
